findings.problem: STALE: the per-chunk writer (top_chunk_ids, top_scores) was restored in production on 2026-08-27 22:18Z (commit 32f78109; query_text deliberately dropped in ffb02a4f 22:39Z). §3.1 says it 'está sem escritor desde 2026-05-19'; the §6 table says 'nulo para sempre depois'; §9 l.1746 is undated. All four are true only for the measured window.
findings.proposed_en:
[§4.5] …search telemetry recorded mostly the cron's health probe: in a closed 7-day window analysed on 2026-08-27, **325 of 343 rows (94.8%)** fall in the two minutes per hour when the cron fires, leaving **2.6 rows/day** attributable to agents. And of the 25 columns of that table, **16 had no writer** in a census taken on 2026-08-27, among them the only one with per-chunk identification (`top_chunk_ids`). Its writer was restored that night (commit `32f78109`, together with `top_scores`; `query_text` deliberately left out), after the window this paper measures.
[§3.1] …and the per-chunk telemetry that could have preserved it had no writer from 2026-05-19 14:47Z until 2026-08-27 22:18Z, that is, for the whole exposure window of this paper (§6).
[§6 table] per-chunk search telemetry **silent** from 2026-05-19 14:47:04, at a deploy boundary (a 1 h 19 min gap in the rows, then null until the writer was restored on 2026-08-27 22:18Z, commit `32f78109`), **without a `CUT`**…
[§9] …**16 telemetry columns without a writer** during the measurement window (census of 2026-08-27), one of them exactly the one that recorded which chunks search returned. It was restored on 2026-08-27, too late for this window (§6).
